appTagline: Connecting rural patients with doctors — even on weak internet.
descLing: Talk to real doctors from your home. No long travel. Safe, simple and made for every family in India.
carouselFamilyCopy: Trusted healthcare for you and your family.
servicesDescription: From choosing a doctor to staying connected with your care, Telehealth Bridge keeps the important things close and easy to use.
serviceTitle1: Find care that fits your needs
serviceText1: Browse doctors by specialty, experience, and availability. Choose the right person for you or someone in your family.
serviceTitle2: Speak with a doctor from home
serviceText2: Get professional guidance without the waiting room. Connect through a simple video consultation from wherever you are.
serviceTitle3: Keep your health in one place
serviceText3: Store consultations, reports, prescriptions, and important health details so they are easier to access when you need them.
serviceText4: Describe your symptoms by typing or voice and organise the details before speaking with a doctor.
familyNote: Simple tools, human doctors, less healthcare hassle.
doctorSectionDescription2: provide trusted care whenever you need it.
fourSteps: Four easy steps to talk to a doctor.
stepText1: Register with your name and phone number. It takes only 2 minutes.
stepText2: See doctors by specialty and language. Pick the one you trust.
stepText3: Select a free time that works for you. Confirm with one click.
stepText4: Join the video call from your phone. Speak freely with the doctor.
storiesDescription1: Real people from towns and villages sharing how
story1Text: “I could talk to a good doctor without going to the city. It saved time and money for my whole family.”
story2Text: “The doctor spoke in Odia. I understood everything clearly. Now I feel more confident about my health.”
story3Text: “Booking was simple even on slow internet. My parents got help without leaving home.”
faqIntro: Clear answers about booking, doctors, language and safety.
faqQuestion1: How do I book a doctor?
faqAnswer1: First make a free account. Then choose a doctor, pick a time, and confirm. You will get a message with all details.
faqQuestion2: Are the doctors real and verified?
faqAnswer2: Yes. Every doctor is checked and verified before they join. You can trust them.
faqQuestion3: Can I talk in my own language?
faqAnswer3: Yes. Many doctors speak Hindi, Odia, and other local languages. You can choose a doctor who speaks your language.
faqAnswer4: Yes. Your health details are private. Only the doctor you choose can see them.
faqQuestion5: What if I need to change the time?
faqAnswer5: You can change or cancel the appointment from your account. Please do it a few hours before the call.
faqQuestion6: Can I speak my problem instead of typing?
faqAnswer6: Yes. You can speak your symptoms. Our system will help write it clearly for the doctor.
